summary.name: Karakeep
summary.one_liner: Karakeep (formerly Hoarder) is an open-source, self-hostable bookmark manager that saves links, notes, images and PDFs and uses AI to tag and organize them for later retrieval.
use_cases: Save and tag web links automatically
Search saved pages by meaning or text
Follow blogs and news via RSS into a searchable archive
Curate a shared reading or book club list
Give AI assistants access to save and search bookmarks
Self-host a private bookmark archive with Docker
summary.what_it_does: Karakeep saves links, notes, images and PDFs from any device, automatically fetching titles, descriptions and images, and keeping full-page archives against link rot. It uses AI to automatically tag and summarize bookmarks and offers full-text, keyword, hybrid and semantic search, with OCR for text in images. Automation rules can tag or move bookmarks based on conditions such as URL patterns, and RSS feeds can be subscribed to so new posts are saved automatically; lists can also be published back out as RSS. It supports sharing lists with editors and viewers, a reader view with highlighting, and an API, CLI and MCP server for scripts and AI agents.
notable: AI auto-tagging and summaries of saved bookmarks
Automation rules and RSS feed ingestion
Fully open source, self-hostable with Docker, with MCP server and CLI
caveats: Page does not state a hosted cloud pricing tier; cloud.karakeep.app is mentioned without price details
Mobile apps are referenced for offline reading but platforms are not fully enumerated on the page
